blocks.text: DETROIT — Cade Cunningham scored 30 points to help the Detroit Pistons hold off the Charlotte Hornets 97-89 in the NBA on Wednesday night. Paul Reed added 16 points and Ausar Thompson had seven points, nine rebounds and eight assists for the Pistons (4-1). They were coming off a 111-97 loss at New York on Tuesday night.
